reviews.title: Blades of Brim review
reviews.text:
Dear SYBO team, 

I REALLY I ENJOY THIS GAME!!! The combat, Characters, Weapons, power up’s. However, there a ton of bugs and issues in the game. At certain points in the game when it slowly gets faster and faster. The Floor Most of the time loads super slow. Almost as if I’m running on air….😹 It’s also super laggy and it freezes randomly so I end up losing my hearts 💔💔

I reallyyyyy want to see more chapters,characters,more complex gameplay, story mode and more. It really gets me when I see the Death Screen because i want to know the reason why he is attacking us,etc..🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

Your Favorite Player,

ArtSorcist

reviews.title: Great Game, But Sadly, it Needs Updates.
reviews.text:
Hello Sybo developers,

Around two years ago, I wrote an impulsive, not thought out review of this game because of one thing I did not like. Even so, I enjoy this game and how it is much more fun and engaging than Subway Surfers. I love how you can grind to get characters, pets, and more while still having fun. Even though this is a great game overall, it has come to my attention that this game has not added any new updates in a significant time period. 
I (and many others) would like this game to get new chapters, weapons, and pets at least. Many people find this annoying that the developers simply ignored the game. I understand you have your financial reasons for not updating this, but please actually consider my review. Don’t get me wrong, I love this game and all it’s aspects, and it is one of my favorites. Have a nice day!

I also request not to get a copy and pasted response, If I get one at all.

ThiswasnotmadeorassistedbyAI. 🥸

reviews.title: One of The Greats, But…
reviews.text: Oh Blades of Brim, my favorite infinite type runner game for many many years. Lots of content to go through, but after that, nothing. Supposed “updates” get pushed out so frequently with nary a whisper of any sort of patch notes. Needless to say I mostly think this game is all but abandoned at this point. Lots to chew on if you’re a beginner, but once you’ve exhausted that content, nothing. I would love some real attention or word from the developers on the state of the game but as it is, I don’t have much hope.
